Piano sound (PianoCoach/PianoSamples/Piano-021.mp3 … Piano-108.mp3)

The recordings of each piano key are the "Acoustic Grand Piano" of the Fluid (R3) General MIDI SoundFont
(FluidR3_GM.sf2) by Frank Wen, as rendered to one MP3 file per key by the MIDI.js Soundfonts project
(https://github.com/gleitz/midi-js-soundfonts, folder FluidR3_GM/acoustic_grand_piano-mp3). The files were
renamed by MIDI note number; they are otherwise unchanged.
